verdict.rationale: Bland's Conversational Pathways let you define how the agent responds at specific points in a conversation. The docs mention a pathway editor with nodes, draft/production versioning, and webhooks at any point, which together point to a node-based flow designer. They never explicitly describe a visual no-code canvas, conditional branching between nodes, state handling, or handoffs to humans or other agents. missing for 10: explicit visual/no-code builder description, documented branching logic, state management, handoff/transfer nodes, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a founder, I can design multi-step conversation flows in a visual builder with branching, states, and handoffs without writing code

citations.quote: Give your agent instructions on how it should respond at specific points of the conversation. Choose between prompting or fixed sentences. Execute webhooks at any point during the conversation
a test chat from the pathway editor — isolate a specific node interaction
